definitions.explanation: A suffix attached to time expressions to indicate an approximate time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{三時|さんじ}→三時：10983_sanji⟧{頃|ごろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会|あ}いましょう→会う：00482_au⟧。
⟦{何時|なんじ}→何時：00973_nanji⟧{頃|ごろ}⟦{着|つ}きます→着く：00680_tsuku⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Around what time will you arrive?

examples.japanese: ⟦{昼|ひる}→昼：00540_hiru⟧{頃|ごろ}⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧。

notes:
USAGE:
Attaches directly to time expressions without particles.
Reading is ごろ as suffix, but ⟦ころ→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧ in {頃|ころ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ or standalone.

EXAMPLES:
- ⟦{七時|しちじ}→七時：10114_shichiji⟧{頃|ごろ}: around 7 o'clock
- ⟦{昼|ひる}→昼：00540_hiru⟧{頃|ごろ}: around noon
- ⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧{頃|ごろ}: around next week
- ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}: when I was a child

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {頃|ごろ}: approximate time (suffix)
- ⟦ぐらい→ぐらい：02900_gurai⟧/⟦くらい→ぐらい：02900_gurai⟧: approximate amount/degree
- {頃|ごろ} is more natural for clock times

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦いつ→いつ：00536_itsu⟧{頃|ごろ}: around when?
- ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧{頃|ころ}: around that time
- ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{頃|ごろ}: these days
